sentences.sk: Peter ide v nedeľu navštíviť svojho brata.
sentences.en: On Sunday Peter goes to visit his brother.

sentences.sk: Jeho brat býva v meste, ktoré je hodinu cesty vlakom.
sentences.en: His brother lives in a town one hour away by train.

sentences.sk: Peter si ráno kúpi lístok cez telefón.
sentences.en: Peter buys a ticket on his phone in the morning.

sentences.sk: Na stanici je o desať minút skôr.
sentences.en: He is at the station ten minutes early.

sentences.sk: Na tabuli hľadá číslo svojho vlaku.
sentences.en: He looks for his train number on the board.

sentences.sk: Vlak ide z nástupišťa číslo dva.
sentences.en: The train leaves from platform number two.

sentences.sk: Peter si kúpi malú fľašu vody.
sentences.en: Peter buys a small bottle of water.

sentences.sk: Potom čaká na lavičke pri nástupišti.
sentences.en: Then he waits on a bench by the platform.

sentences.sk: Vedľa neho sedí žena s dieťaťom.
sentences.en: A woman with a child sits next to him.

sentences.sk: Dieťa sa pýta, kedy príde vlak.
sentences.en: The child asks when the train will arrive.

sentences.sk: Mama dieťaťa ukáže na hodiny nad dverami.
sentences.en: The child’s mother points to the clock above the door.

sentences.sk: Vlak príde presne o deviatej.
sentences.en: The train arrives at exactly nine.

sentences.sk: Peter nastúpi a nájde voľné miesto pri okne.
sentences.en: Peter gets on and finds an empty seat by the window.

sentences.sk: Vonku vidí domy, polia a malé dediny.
sentences.en: Outside he sees houses, fields, and small villages.

sentences.sk: Počas cesty pošle bratovi krátku správu.
sentences.en: During the trip he sends his brother a short message.

sentences.sk: Brat mu odpovie, že čaká pred stanicou.
sentences.en: His brother replies that he is waiting in front of the station.

sentences.sk: O hodinu vlak zastaví v bratovom meste.
sentences.en: An hour later the train stops in his brother’s town.

sentences.sk: Peter vystúpi a hneď uvidí svojho brata.
sentences.en: Peter gets off and immediately sees his brother.

sentences.sk: Spolu idú pešo do neďalekej reštaurácie.
sentences.en: Together they walk to a nearby restaurant.

sentences.sk: Peter sa teší na obed a na spoločné popoludnie.
sentences.en: Peter looks forward to lunch and an afternoon together.

glossary.note: Masculine noun; here a train ticket.

questions.explanationEn: The train leaves from platform two.
Peter finds a seat by the window.
Peter’s brother says he is waiting in front of the station.
